brief.claim: The compound raises the share of cells that respond to stimulation: the proportion of responding cells is higher in treated wells than in untreated wells, and a test of the difference between the two groups gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: whether each imaged cell of each well showed a calcium response to the stimulus
whether the well was given the compound before stimulation

brief.sizes: wells = 12; cells = 150 (responded: 12 x 150 = 1800 values; treated: 12 values)
